description: Autonomous source reputation registry for Australian immigration intelligence

sources.name: Department of Home Affairs (ImmiAccount & Visa Finder)
sources.notes: Primary statutory authority for visas, fees, gazettes, and SkillSelect invitation rounds.

sources.name: Minister for Home Affairs & Immigration Media Center
sources.notes: Official ministerial press releases, planning level speeches, and policy directives.

sources.name: Federal Register of Legislation
sources.notes: Legally binding Migration Regulations 1994, statutory instruments, and legislative amendments.

sources.name: Parliament of Australia (Hansard & Bills)
sources.notes: Official Hansard debate transcripts, Joint Standing Committee on Migration reports, and tabled bills.

sources.name: Victoria State Government (Live in Melbourne)
sources.notes: Victoria Subclass 190/491 Registration of Interest (ROI) guidelines and round results.

sources.name: Investment NSW / NSW Migration
sources.notes: NSW skilled lists, Subclass 190 invitation rounds, and regional nomination policies.

sources.name: Migration Western Australia
sources.notes: WA State Nominated Migration Program (SNMP) invitation rounds and occupation lists.

sources.name: Migration Queensland (BSMQ)
sources.notes: Queensland Subclass 190 and 491 criteria, quota tracking, and family sponsorship conditions.

sources.name: Australian Computer Society (ACS)
sources.notes: ICT skills assessments, ANZSCO 2613/2631 guidelines, multi-code submission rules, payment evidence criteria.

sources.name: VETASSESS
sources.notes: General professional and trade occupation assessments, priority processing circulars.

sources.name: Reddit r/AusVisa Community
sources.notes: Self-reported invitation cutoffs, lodgement turnaround timelines, grant timestamps. Unverified until corroborated.

sources.name: Whirlpool Immigration Forum
sources.notes: Long-running threads tracking specific visa subclass grant dates, case officer queries, and verification calls.
